title: Oily Melt Malaysian Jerusalem Artichokes Ramen
description: A nostalgic Malaysian dish featuring fresh Jerusalem artichokes, shio-koji-cure, and a rich cheese-pull.

ingredients.name: Shio-koji
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the tapioca starch and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the shio-koji, water, chicken broth, ginger, and garlic. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Peel and slice the Jerusalem artichoke tubers into thin rounds.
Add the sliced artichokes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the pot to a baking dish and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
